dialog.body: Hello, thank you for contacting Old Stone Auto Insurance. My name is Jeffrey Martin. May I have your name, please?
Hi, my name is Amber Thompson.
Nice to meet you, Amber. Could you kindly provide me with your policy number?
Sure, my policy number is seven eight four five six.
Thank you, Amber. Additionally, could you provide me with the date of the incident?
The incident occurred on the twelfth of September, twenty twenty-one.
Thank you for the information. We will review and update your claim. Is there anything else you need assistance with today, Amber?
No, that's all for now. Thank you.
You're welcome, Amber. Thank you for choosing Old Stone Auto Insurance. Have a great day!
